verdict.rationale: Bolna is open-source (bolna-gh-1) and supports self-hosting (bolna-docs-9), which gives some data portability/exit path, and the API/CLI let you fetch transcripts and recordings per call (bolna-docs-14, bolna-docs-34, bolna-docs-16). But there is no documented bulk/full-account data-export feature or open-format export tool for all agent, call, and analytics data at once. Missing for 10: a documented bulk export endpoint/tool covering all data types, explicit open-format (e.g., CSV/JSON) export guarantee, and any independent confirmation of a full data-portability workflow.
